name: j5-macro-debug
description: Debug j5-macro YAML scripts in VS Code: breakpoints on steps, stepping, variables and expressions; capture templates, pick points and test matches.

program.description: Path of the j5 YAML script to debug.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause before the first step (the engine's step mode).

params.description: Values for the script's declared params, by name. Prefer paramsFromEnv for secrets.

paramsFromEnv.description: Params read from environment variables of the adapter process: param name to variable name.

seed.description: Seed of the run, to repeat the same human-like input.

dryRun.description: Send no input: input steps describe what they would do, image searches run once.

strict.description: With dryRun: fail the step where a dry run would only warn that the real run fails (an image not found, a missing window, vision not available, exec not allowed).

fast.description: Use the direct input strategy for mouse and keyboard (no human-like movement).

allowExec.description: Let the script's exec steps run programs (without it they fail with capability_missing).

displayScale.description: The display scale of the run (1.5 for 150 %), instead of detecting it per monitor; templates and pixel offsets are scaled by it over the script's capture_scale.

noDebug.description: Run without stopping at breakpoints (also set by Run Without Debugging).

cwd.description: Directory a relative program path is resolved against.

python.description: Python interpreter with j5-macro installed; the adapter is started as '<python> -m j5_macro.dap' instead of 'j5 dap'.

configurationSnippets.label: j5: Debug script
configurationSnippets.description: Debug the j5 YAML script in the active editor.

configurationSnippets.label: j5: Dry run
configurationSnippets.description: Step through a script without sending any input.

configurationSnippets.label: j5: Debug script with params
configurationSnippets.description: Pass the script's params, secrets from the environment.

j5.adapterCommand.description: Command that starts the j5 debug adapter, e.g. ["/path/to/venv/bin/j5", "dap"]. Empty: 'j5 dap' from the PATH. A launch configuration's 'python' wins over this.

j5.command.description: Command that runs the j5 CLI for the commands Capture template, Pick point, Find image and Pack script, e.g. ["/path/to/venv/bin/j5"]. Empty: j5.adapterCommand without its "dap", else 'j5' from the PATH.
